dispute.claim_text: I chose pool to save money. Three other people got in and out. My bill is 174 dollars for 61 kilometres and an hour and a half. My trip is 32 kilometres. They charged me for everybody's trip. What is the point of pool?

counterparty_statement.text: Pool routes are long; that's how pool works. The app splits the fare, not me.
